description: Multiple-testing correction for a list of p-values: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values and Benjamini-Yekutieli, Holm, Hochberg and Bonferroni adjusted p-values, the number of discoveries at alpha for each method, and the Benjamini-Hochberg cutoff rank. Pass family_size when more tests were run than the p-values supplied (for example only the top hits were kept). Up to 10,000 p-values per call; the same implementation as cybergenic.im/tools/fdr-correction, verified against R p.adjust and statsmodels.

alpha.description: Significance level for counting discoveries. Default 0.05.

family_size.description: Total number of tests run, when larger than the number of p-values supplied.

labels.description: Optional names for the tests, in the same order as p_values.

p_values.description: The raw p-values, one per test.

name: fdr_correction
title: FDR and multiple-testing correction
